narr: Numerous thunderstorms developed during the afternoon of the 16th and again during the day on June 17th. Some storm clusters became severe and produced damaging winds as they moved northeast across the area. Additionally, locally heavy rainfall produced some flash flooding.
ev: Flooding was reported at Military Rd and Black Creek Rd along with Willowbrook Rd between 5th and 7th St.
lsr: Flooding was reported at Military Rd and Black Creek Rd and at Willowbrook Rd between 5th and 7th St.
